dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire Another one: Is it true that in the United States every citizen has a car? This is true in principle, but in the Soviet Union everyone has their own car park.
@dogecoin_empire I also like that one: Is it true that the poet Mayakovsky committed suicide? This is true, and his last words are also known: Don't shoot, comrades!

@dogecoin_empire Next to big,all radio Erevan jokes are the truth. I like that one:  Is it true that there is a severe shortage of flour in the country? This has been true in principle since flour was introduced into bread baking.
